content: MMO death-alert prior art (WoW): Death Alerts addon reports party/raid member death plus cause of death and damage taken; DeathAlert plays a sound and shows name+role of the dead player on screen and in chat; Deathlog captures group member deaths even for players without the addon and does global death chat notification; WeakAura death strings show the dead player name with role-specific sounds. Common feature set = who died (name), role/class, cause, distinct alerting channel per severity. AFK Guard (WoW private-tool) forwards in-game events - disconnects, whispers, found items, killed-by-player - to Discord/phone with a dashboard and character reports; it is the closest analog to a screen-monitor-to-messenger pipeline.
